title: Delicious Irish Cottage Pie
description: A hearty, comforting Irish dish made with ground meat, lentils, and a crispy mashed potato topping.

ingredients.name: Ground Northern Irish Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 or 70/30 lean to fat ratio works well

instructions: Cook the ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Stir in the lentils, beef broth, and cottage cheese. Bring to a simmer and cook until the liquid has thickened slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the meat mixture to a 20x20cm baking dish.
Top with the mashed potatoes, spreading them evenly to cover the meat.
Use a spatula to create a decorative edge around the potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
